summary: Phase 4 Market Leader Features - Complete Testing. All 17 backend API tests PASSED (100%). All 14+ frontend checks PASSED (100%). Features tested: Health Plans subscription (3 plans with correct prices), Prescription Photo Upload, Family Profiles CRUD, Medicine Stock Status, Post-visit Recommendations API.

test_credentials.access_method: Click Guest button on intro screen

seed_data_creation: Test subscriptions, prescriptions, and family members created during testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 4 features verified working. Health Plans API returns 3 plans (diabetes-care: ₹499, womens-health: ₹599, family-wellness: ₹999). Prescription upload uses multipart form data to /api/pharmacy/upload-prescription. Family members API uses query param ?phone= for POST. Stock update uses query params not form data.

backend_apis.GET /api/health-plans: PASS - Returns 3 plans with correct ids and prices
backend_apis.POST /api/health-plans/subscribe: PASS - Creates subscription with plan_id, phone, patient_name
backend_apis.POST /api/pharmacy/upload-prescription: PASS - Accepts multipart form data (file, phone, notes)
backend_apis.POST /api/family/members: PASS - Creates family member (name, relation, age, gender, blood_group)
backend_apis.DELETE /api/family/members/{id}: PASS - Deletes member, returns 404 for nonexistent
backend_apis.GET /api/appointments/{id}/recommendatio: PASS - Returns 404 for nonexistent, medicines/lab_tests arrays for valid
backend_apis.GET /api/pharmacy/stock-status: PASS - Returns medicines array, supports ?search= filter
backend_apis.POST /api/pharmacy/update-stock: PASS - Uses query params (medicine_name, stock_status, stock_quantity)
